title: Relative Pronouns
intro: Relative pronouns connect clauses by referring back to a noun. The main relative pronoun is который (which/who/that). It agrees in GENDER and NUMBER with the noun it refers to, but its CASE depends on its role in the relative clause. If который is the subject of the clause, it's nominative; if it's the object, it's accusative; and so on. This is one of the trickiest grammar points!
rules: Который agrees in gender/number with its antecedent: Девушка, которая... (The girl who...)
Case of который depends on its role in the clause: subject = nom, object = acc, etc.
Nominative: Человек, который пришёл... (The person who came...) - который is subject.
Accusative: Книга, которую я читаю... (The book that I'm reading...) - которую is object.
Который declines like a regular adjective (новый pattern): который, которого, которому, которым, о котором.
examples: Человек, который звонил, — мой друг. (The person who called is my friend.), nom
Книга, которую я читаю, интересная. (The book that I'm reading is interesting.), acc
Друг, которому я помогаю, студент. (The friend whom I help is a student.), dat
Дом, в котором я живу, старый. (The house in which I live is old.), prep

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Который in different cases depending on role in clause
hints: С (with) requires instrumental case. What is the masculine instrumental form of который?
Студент is masculine. Который is the subject of 'пришёл' — what case is that?
Книга is feminine. Которую is the object of 'читаю' — what case and gender?
explanations: С requires instrumental case: которым (masculine instrumental, like новым).
Который is the subject (nominative) of the relative clause: который пришёл.
Книга is feminine and которую is the direct object (accusative): которую я читаю.

minimalPairs.context: Человек, _____ я видел... (whom I saw) - object

hints: Fill in the oblique cases for который
explanations: Accusative = genitive for animate: который → которого
Dative: который → которому (same pattern as adjectives)
Prepositional: который → котором (same pattern as adjectives)
